#include <assert.h>

    assert(api_key != NULL && "API_KEY must be set");
    LITERLLMAlefHandle create_batch_request_handle = literllm_create_batch_request_from_json("{\"completion_window\":\"24h\",\"endpoint\":\"/v1/chat/completions\",\"input_file_id\":\"file-wrong-purpose\"}");
    if (create_batch_request_handle == 0) { return EXIT_SUCCESS; }
    LITERLLMAlefHandle client = literllm_create_client(api_key, NULL, (uint64_t)-1, (uint32_t)-1, NULL);
    assert(client != 0 && "failed to create client");
    LITERLLMAlefHandle result = literllm_default_client_create_batch(client, create_batch_request_handle);
    if (result != 0) { return EXIT_FAILURE; }
    literllm_create_batch_request_free(create_batch_request_handle);
    literllm_default_client_free(client);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
